{{Quote|We have no time to lose. Hunnos Jarkey is a dangerous murderer. The longer he is loose, the longer innocent people are potentially in danger.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sundria Khartoor|Khartoor]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />}}
'''Hunnos Jarkey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My lousy, good for nothing son, I mean. Escapes from the RSF and doesn't even bother to come see his father.|[[Ados Jarkey]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />}}
Hunnos Jarkey was the son of [[Ados Jarkey]] and the brother of [[Fenrol Jarkey]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he had become a murderer but managed to escape the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG:FaEM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sundria Khartoor|Khartoor]] of the [[Royal Security Police Force|Violent Crimes Division]] was tasked to arrest Jarkey.<ref name="SWG:FaEM" /> The wanted murderer sought for help among different criminal groups. He first joined the [[Muskegs]] but they commanded him to assassinate members of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo human government]]. Fleeing the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] fanatics, he hid for a short time in the [[Skaak Tipper Compound]] and in the [[Mummer bunker]].<ref name="SWG:CaEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Chase an Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref> Jarkey eventually recruited a small army of [[Naboo pirates]] and fortified a [[Hunnos Jarkey's Ranch|ranch]] near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Nevertheless, Hunnos Jarkey and all pirates were killed during the final RSF assault.<ref name="SWG:CtEM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hunnos Jarkey appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CtEM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hunnos Jarkey was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
